newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover amounted to 497,979 denars with 193 shares changing hands, up from 130 units at the previous session on Thursday.
Gradski Targovski Centar AD sold 20 shares at 1,864 denars each on the first floor, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,662 denars.
A total of 173 Gradinar-Loza AD shares sold on the third floor at 2,663 denars, down two from Thursday and above par of 2,662.

Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=40.53 denars; 1DEM=26.62 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981 4145
